Description:

=============================================
[b]Disclaimer:
-Please don't re-upload or re-distribute or edit/trace over my Mod/ Sprites and especially not behind a paywall! It would be very disrespectful of my efforts and work plus it's not a nice thing to do. This was done just so I could practice doing sprites and is meant to be free to enjoy and not for profit. They may not be amazing but I did work hard on them.
-Please don't add any of my stuff to Mod Packs even with credit. People barely read the credits and it kinda takes away from this mod and the possibility for feedback. If you would like to, for whatever reason, contact me and ask first! I would like to check out the mod first and maybe help push it
-I also do take commissions for sprite sheets.
This mod should only be available for download here on Nexus and on the stardewvalley mod forum under the username "thatotterthing"
Please let me know if you see this mod anywhere else.
[/b][/center]

[b]Content patcher Instructions:[/b]
⦁   Install SMAPI
⦁   Install Content Patcher
⦁   Extract into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder (or where ever you installed your SMAPI mods folder)

[b]manual Instructions:[/b]
⦁   open the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10950]Jorts and Jean[/url] mod folder and navigate to images
⦁   replace the sprite files in that folder with the downloaded sprite files
⦁   be sure to save the original files elsewhere if you want to change back! or re-download then original mod again. 

[center]﻿[/center][center]Note: This sprite mod was made with permission from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/112768378]Tiakall[/url]﻿, the original creator of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10950]Jorts and Jean the Helper Cats[/url] mod, and I do not claim any credit for the characters or original mod. I only made these Sprite sheets in my style for fun and for and an alternative style and am in no way affiliated with all the hard work that went into the original mod. Please go check out and compliment [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/112768378]Tiakall[/url]﻿ for their hard work and creativity with the mod and it's characters and always to remember to ask and credit your mod creators before modifying! they are incredible folks! ﻿[/center]
